reviews.comment: Genuinely the worst professor I have ever had or even heard about. Do everything in your power to not take her class, but if you do, you will have to study everyday of the semester. Say goodbye to your friends and family or anything you enjoy doing.

Dr. Barrufet is caring, accessible, and offers PLENTY of helpful resources, weekly homework that PREPARES WELL FOR EXAMS, and fair grading from her amazing TA, Corine. However, lectures are hard to follow, and she can come off as unreasonably harsh or frustrated sometimes. Respectful overall, but I wouldn't take her again.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Barrufet has completely changed this past year for the best. She has made the class easier in a way, so don't listen to the old ratings. This class is hard, yes, BUT put in work and show her you care and you are gonna do fine. Do everything with intention, don't do it to "just get it done". Study like there is no tomorrow and you will make it!
Pick a god and start praying you're actually cooked.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Go through the homework and study the assignments before exams and you'll be fine. Barrufet is actually pretty gracious; the final is optional if you're passing, and you can still take it to improve your grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The bad reviews on here are what I would consider sour students who did not get spoon fed an A. She is one of the best professors in this department. Is this class difficult, yes, but that does not make it impossible. Show that your care day one and engage in class and you will more than succeed. She is an amazing professor. Do not be discouraged.
good prof. very good class
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very nice professor, If you do the homework, and study a bit for the exams you will be fine.  She gives you the required equations for each problem on the exams which makes them much easier.  The exams are worth 90% of your grade but are extremely fair and cover the material on the homework and lectures well without being punishing.

Professor truly cares about the students and wants everyone to learn. It is sad seeing how bad people think she is as a person. She can be a bit intimidating at first but she will help you if you show her you are trying. If you show up and try to learn she will be there to see you succeed

Her ta is a tough grader and is strict. it's hard to understand what the professor is saying. She doesn't teach you how to solve problems that can be in exams but only verbally what is on the homework but doesn't really explain how to solve. 3 exams each worth 30%, hw and quiz each 5%. You don't have to take the final if ur grade C+.

Although sometimes this class gets a bad rap, Dr. Barrufet truly cares about her students and will work with you for success. The ALs are challenging as well as the exams, but as long as you put the long hours in you will have a fighting chance at surviving thermodynamics.

reviews.comment: Pay attention in class and take notes

reviews.comment: I actually liked Dr. Barrufet. Don't get me wrong this class is hard and takes a lot of effort and studying if you want a good grade but it's possible. My advice would be to work with a group of people when doing the ALs and study with a group of people who care. Also, go to office hours they're helpful.
